newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq slips, investors await economic clues.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq slips, investors await economic clues.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks fell on Monday for the third straight market sessison as investors stayed on the sidelines awaiting further clues about the health of the U.S. economy, traders said.
The Nasdaq Composite index fell almost seven, or 0.55 percent, to close unofficially at 1216.
Several key economic indicators are due this week icluding third quarter GDP, October consumer confidence, and the third quarter Employment Cost Index.
Losing stocks solidly bested gainers by a 3 to 2 margin on unofficial volume of 513 million shares.

The Nasdaq's most active issue was also the stock that suffered the most: Physician Reliance Network lost half its value, falling 4-5/8 to 4-7/8 after it predicted fourth quarter earnings would be match the third quarter.
Fuisz Technology was also the victim of poor earnings. The stock fell 5-7/8 to 8 after the company posted a third quarter loss and predicted a loss for the fourth quarter and the year.
